```sql
select
  NULL as key,
  cast(count(a.attempt_id) * 1.0 / count(distinct o.order_id) as decimal(38,12)) as value
from orders o
join showrooms s on s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
left join payment_attempts a
  on a.order_id = o.order_id
 and not a.is_test
where not o.is_test
  and s.country_code = 'IN'
order by value
```
